subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@paybridge.com>; Emily Wong <emily@paybridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Hi Samuel / Emily —

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation and appreciate the context on PayBridge's fraud-screening pilot. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- What we demoed: Hosted API text-generation + streaming for transaction enrichment and a small batching pattern for batch-scoring.
- Your primary objectives: low-latency enrichment for decisioning (<200ms p95), predictable per-token cost for pilot, and no on-prem procurement in phase 1.
- Deployment preference: leaning toward Hosted API for the pilot (fast onboarding), but you flagged Dedicated capacity if throughput grows quickly or for specific PCI/segregation needs.

Action items / next steps:
1) I’ll send a short quickstart guide and test endpoints so your engs can spin up a dev key and run basic calls. (attached: redwood-hosted-quickstart-guide.pdf)
2) Neha (cc’d) will follow up with the team on rate-limit profiles and recommended tenant config for your expected QPS.
3) If the pilot shows >200 TPS sustained we’ll discuss Dedicated options and pricing.

Quick answers to the questions you raised on the call:
- Test endpoints: we'll provide a sandbox API key and a dedicated sandbox endpoint (see links below).
- Rate limits for Hosted API sandbox: nominally 60 requests/min by default for new sandboxes; we can provision a higher profile for pilots (1000r/min or custom) with a short lead time.
- Data / retention: Hosted API can be configured with customer-managed deletion policies; we don’t persist customer prompts beyond configured retention in the sandbox.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quickstart-guide.pdf (quickstart steps + sample curl and Node snippets), rate_limits_matrix.xlsx (reference limits/profiles).

Would you like us to provision a sandbox tenant today? If so I can have Neha send the token and the endpoint details within the hour.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@paybridge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Wong <emily@paybridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap. A couple quick clarifications from our engineering lead's side: 

1) For the sandbox tenant, can you confirm the exact streaming endpoint URL and the header name for the API key? We have a quick automation that expects a header like X-API-KEY.
2) For the rate limits: 1000r/min sounds fine for the pilot. Will that support streaming responses concurrently? Our enrichment flow streams a 1–2 token summary per transaction.
3) Any client libs you recommend? We primarily use Node and Python.

Also, any chance you can include an estimate for monthly cost for a pilot that processes ~3M tokens/month and peaks at ~250 TPS for short windows? We need a rough number to get expedited approval from procurement.

If it helps I’m happy for Neha to have a quick 15-min sync with our eng lead today.

— Sam
Senior Engineering Manager | PayBridge
samuel.ortiz@paybridge.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@paybridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emily Wong <emily@paybridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Sam —

Thanks — good questions. See answers below and next steps at the bottom. Quoting your key points inline for clarity:

> 1) For the sandbox tenant, can you confirm the exact streaming endpoint URL and the header name for the API key? We have a quick automation that expects a header like X-API-KEY.

- Sandbox streaming endpoint: https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
- Auth header: Authorization: Bearer <key> is primary; we can also support X-API-KEY for automation. I’ll include both examples in the quickstart snippets (attached PDF & quickstart link).

> 2) For the rate limits: 1000r/min sounds fine for the pilot. Will that support streaming responses concurrently? Our enrichment flow streams a 1–2 token summary per transaction.

- Yes. The 1000r/min profile supports concurrent streaming sessions; streaming is counted as requests not per-token for quota, but per-token billing still applies. For short spikes to ~250 TPS we recommend enabling a burst profile (we can enable a temporary burst to 500 TPS for the pilot window). Neha will provision that on the sandbox and share concrete headers for rate-limit and quota responses.

> 3) Any client libs you recommend? We primarily use Node and Python.

- Official SDKs: @redwoodai/node and redwoodai-python. Both support streaming helpers (EventSource/async iterators) and include the auth header examples. Sample snippets are in the quickstart doc and on the sandbox quickstart page: https://app.redwood.ai/quickstart/paybridge

Cost estimate (very rough for procurement):
- 3M tokens/month (mixed input+output) on Hosted API with our gpt-like open model profile = ~$1,800–$2,400/mo depending on average output length and any sampling overhead.
- If you move to Dedicated later (reserved GPU pool) you can expect lower per-token unit cost but there’s a base reserved capacity commit — we can model both with exact workload traces if you’d like.

Attachments: I’ve attached the rate_limits_matrix.xlsx with the sandbox and production profiles we discussed.

Next steps:
- Neha: can you provision the sandbox tenant (1000r/min + burst to 500 TPS) and share the sandbox API key and endpoint? A 15-min sync with PayBridge eng lead today would be great — Sam, what time window works for you (we’re available 2:30–4pm PT).
- Sam/Emily: confirm you want the sandbox provisioned today and I’ll mark it as reserved on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to getting your team into the sandbox.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
